description: The Spartan Infrared Camera is a high-resolution near-infrared imager on the 4.1-meter SOAR Telescope, built by Michigan State University, providing wide-field and high-resolution imaging in J, H, K, and narrow-band filters.
facility_description: The Southern Astrophysical Research (SOAR) 4.1-meter Telescope is located on Cerro Pachón, Chile, operated by NSF NOIRLab.
notes: Built by MSU for SOAR. Laboratory filter transmission scans were carried out at cryogenic temperatures.
